findings.current: “That quack calling himself the Medicine King Hall Master is right for once. You just focus on recovering. The rest will be taken care of by the others.”
findings.defect: “Right for once” implies rare agreement; 백번 옳다 emphatically says the physician is right.
findings.rationale: Jeok Cheongang fully endorses the demand that Jin Wikyung rest, despite insulting the physician.
findings.replacement: “That quack they call the Medicine King Hall Master is absolutely right. You focus on recovering. The others will take care of the rest.”
findings.source: “약왕당주인지 뭔지 하는 저 돌팔이 말이 백번 옳다. 네 녀석은 몸이나 추스르고 있거라. 남은 일은 다른 놈들이 알아서 처리할 것인즉.”

findings.current: But at their head stood a giant whom even Peng Cheolyeong, Family Head of the Hebei Peng Family, could not dare to stand before.
findings.defect: “Stand before” can suggest facing the giant rather than taking a position ahead of her.
findings.rationale: 앞에 설 수 없는 establishes the Bow Saint’s precedence at the head of the returning force.
findings.replacement: But leading them was a giant whom even Peng Cheolyeong, Family Head of the Hebei Peng Family, would not dare step ahead of.
findings.source: 그러나 그런 그들의 선두에는, 하북팽가의 가주인 팽철영조차 감히 앞에 설 수 없는 거인이 있었다.

findings.current: “Is that what you say to someone who came all this way to help you?”
findings.defect: The line drops both the journey of thousands of li and Jeong Hogun’s teasing claim to be Taekyung’s Benefactor.
findings.rationale: Both 수천 리 and 은인 are explicit, and the latter sets up Taekyung’s retort that he helped Jeong first.
findings.replacement: “Is that what you say to a Benefactor who traveled thousands of li to help you?”
findings.source: “그것이 수천 리 길을 마다하고 도우러 온 은인에게 할 말인가?”

findings.current: “Wait… Why the hell didn’t you tell me sooner?”
findings.defect: The profanity moves into an adverb and drops Taekyung’s direct insult to Mujin.
findings.rationale: 이 새끼야 is a direct, irritated address that punctures Taekyung’s solemn thoughts.
findings.replacement: “Wait… Why are you only telling me now, you bastard?”
findings.source: “아니……. 그걸 왜 이제 말해, 이 새끼야.”

findings.current: “You suddenly got this intense look in your eyes and struck a cool pose.”
findings.defect: A facial expression becomes a bodily pose.
findings.rationale: 멋있는 표정을 짓고 refers to the expression on Taekyung’s face.
findings.replacement: “Well, you suddenly got this intense look in your eyes and started making a cool face.”
findings.source: “그게 좀, 갑자기 눈에 힘주고 멋있는 표정을 짓고 계시길래.”

findings.current: The young chieftain who had once dreamed of uniting the vast steppe as its Great Khan submitted without a word of protest.
findings.defect: “Without a word of protest” replaces Temur’s defeated, strengthless manner with mere compliance.
findings.rationale: 힘없이 characterizes how he submits, not whether he voices an objection.
findings.replacement: The young chieftain who had once dreamed of uniting the vast steppe as its Great Khan submitted helplessly.
findings.source: 한때 광활한 초원을 아우르는 대칸을 꿈꾸었던 젊은 부족장은 힘없이 복종했다.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but it changes one emphatic endorsement, obscures who leads the Hebei force, and loses several characterizing cues.
